matchups.task: Build a one-page SaaS product landing page (working HTML/CSS) from a one-paragraph product brief
matchups.why: AI landing-page builders are the hottest 'tested & compared' category online right now, but nobody's checking if the page actually renders and converts.

matchups.task: Turn a messy list of monthly expenses into a formatted budget spreadsheet with working formulas and a chart
matchups.why: Everyday spreadsheet work is where AI claims save the most time, but formula correctness is easy to fake in a chat reply and hard to fake in a real .xlsx.

matchups.task: Draft a one-page investor pitch deck (PPTX) for a fictional early-stage startup from a short brief
matchups.why: Pitch decks are a classic AI use case, and Canva's Magic Design has matured enough this year to be a fair fourth contender against the chat-native tools.

matchups.task: Write and run a small file-organizing automation script from a plain-English spec, and verify it actually works on sample files
matchups.why: Coding agents are the biggest AI category of 2026 per this month's news, and 'it compiles' is a much lower bar than 'it did the task correctly on real files.'

matchups.task: Draft a professional resignation letter plus a short two-week-notice email from a few bullet points about the situation
matchups.why: A high-stakes personal writing task where fabricated details or off-key tone are actively harmful, not just annoying.
